notes: Deletes an assertion (present twice) and leaves a comment explaining why the value is not checked. Only one of the two files is kept. Policy reject: the maintainers explain that the asserted state legitimately varies, and no diff rule can tell that apart from deleting an inconvenient assertion. Under the strict assertion principle a removed assertion passes only if an added assertion in the same test method keeps its strength, and none does. Ruled together with reject-id-remove-order-assertion and reject-id-remove-unstable-assert. In the source, the pull request description declares that the change was AI generated; it is used here as a real merged change and recorded as such.
